editor_fail.fix: Use a clear photo of Chief Justice of India Surya Kant as the main picture (try the library, quick_photo.py and the finder for 'Surya Kant'); keep the smog photo as the in-story photo with its caption.

fixed_by_run.why: Main picture shows a wall with two air-conditioner units and pipes; nothing in it identifies the Reserve Bank headquarters or the rupee. It reads as a generic stand-in (rule 3) and the caption does not match what is shown (rule 6).

fixed_by_run.why: Main picture is a steep upward shot of the RBI tower that looks rotated sideways; as a homepage thumbnail it is an unidentifiable grey slab with a traffic light, badly framed and not recognisable (rule 3, rule 13).

fixed_by_run.why: 1) Balance (rule 11): two business stories sit in the top headlines, stacked in the same column (RBI forex reserves and Markets rupee), and they are on the same subject (rupee/RBI dollar flows) next to each other; keep only one (the rupee close) in the top block and move forex reserves down to Economy. 2) Lead (rule 10): a contempt notice to a state Congress unit leads while the Cyclone Murasu damage estimate (8 dead, about Rs 1,919 crore, 1.4 lakh hectares of crops), the running national story frontpages.txt lists, sits in a side slot; lead with the Murasu damage story (with the damage photo) and move the contempt notice to a top slot. 3) Empty space (rule 9): in the red Courts 'Live coverage' block the right column has a large empty red gap between the Tejpal item and 'Read the full story'; fill it with another Courts item or shorten the block. 4) Repetition (rule 13): the Tejpal sentence story appears twice, in the Courts block and again as a card in the India section; drop one, and the Courts block labelled 'Live coverage' carries no live coverage, only two explainers and an unrelated case, so relabel it or make it a real running file.
fixed_by_run.done: lead moved to the Murasu damage story (--lead); forex reserves dropped from the top block (--drop) so only the rupee story is in it; duplicate Tejpal item dropped (--drop); pollution story held, so it leaves the Courts live band.
